pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-350 was wet clean with wall buildup removed, 5 dummy seasoning wafers already run, pre-PM recipe 62.1 s, baseline clean chamber 60.0 s, target 500.0 A with control limits 493.0 to 507.0 A and spec 485.0 to 515.0 A.

Similar history wet clean with 5 dummy wafers had first wafers vs later -0.16 A and slope -0.05 A per lot, wet clean with skipped seasoning had -8.29 A and slope -0.07 A per lot, wet clean with new showerhead had -0.36 A and slope -0.92 A per lot indicating no fast drift for current clean without parts.
Tool matching checked 17.4 hours ago on certified 500.0 A reference: MET01 reads 500.04 A, MET02 reads 500.34 A, difference 0.3 A negligible.
Monitor 1 runs since PM 1 at time 60.0 s measured 493.9 A with rate 8.2317 A per s confirming cleaned chamber rate.
Estimate from monitors gives rate 8.2115 A per s and recipe 60.89 s, change -1.95 percent vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 509.93 A.
Controller default lambda 0.3 with measured lot fraction 0.5 is appropriate for standard wet clean recovery.

release.summary: Wet clean with seasoning so monitors are representative. Monitors at 60s show clean rate higher than pre-PM, old 62.1s would run thick near 510A. New 60.89s hits target, small change, no fast thinning expected, metrology offset negligible, EWMA 0.3 with no drift compensation.
